articles.title: Natalie Harp Backed Katie Zacharia’s Hiring? Trump’s Press Secretary Is Out After Just Seven Days
articles.description: Natalie Harp reportedly helped push Katie Zacharia’s appointment as White House press secretary, but just seven days later, Zacharia was out of the job. According to RadarOnline, sources claimed Harp played a significant role in advancing Zacharia’s hiring after she travelled from California to Washington to meet Donald Trump on October 8. The following day, she was reportedly offered the position. However, The Wall Street Journal reported that Zacharia learned she was being pushed out on October 16. Trump later questioned whether she truly wanted the role. Harp’s reported influence and the abrupt reversal have fuelled fresh speculation about power dynamics inside the White House. The claims about Harp’s role remain attributed to sources, and the full circumstances behind the decision are not publicly established.
